headline: Palandöken's Proposal: Special Consumption Tax on Diesel Should Be Lifted for the Entire Year
summary: TESK President Bendevi Palandöken demanded the lifting of the special consumption tax on diesel for the entire year. He found its reset for the rest of August positive but insufficient.
why: Fuel taxes feed directly into diesel costs for transport and small businesses, and changes to them affect inflation and corporate margins.
